lead.headline: ETSU and Furman rate highest, and The Citadel has won three straight
lead.deck: Eleven schools across the Southern Appalachians and the Piedmont. Four of them rate in our national top 150.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Southern Conference, 11 schools from Lexington, Virginia to Birmingham. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
ETSU rates highest at 106th despite a 1-2 start, after road losses at Arizona State and NC State and a 68-53 win over Campbell.
Furman (108th) won its first four, including 98-83 over Northern Iowa, before losing 72-62 at Belmont on Saturday.
Chattanooga won 77-70 at Elon on Friday. Tennessee Tech, new to the league this season, beat Western Kentucky 97-94.
The Citadel has won three straight, the last a 77-74 win at North Florida on Saturday as a 3.5-point underdog.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **4.** SoCon teams in our national top 150: ETSU, Furman, Western Carolina and Chattanooga.
**97.** Points Mercer scored in an overtime win at Georgia Southern.
**11.** Teams in the SoCon this season, with Tennessee Tech joining from the OVC.

notes.headline: Western Carolina on the road
notes.body: The Catamounts won 83-75 at UNC Asheville and lost by eight at North Carolina.

notes.headline: Wofford's week
notes.body: The Terriers lost 97-92 at Queens on Saturday after road losses at Tennessee and North Carolina.

notes.headline: VMI's streak
notes.body: The Keydets have won two straight, including 65-51 over North Carolina Central.

notes.headline: Asheville in March
notes.body: The SoCon tournament is played in Asheville, and its winner takes the league's NCAA bid.
